===Specifications=== :'''Banana Pi RPI R3 Mini''' board *CPU: [[MediaTek]] MT7986A (''Filogic 830'') :Quad-Core ARM (Cortex-A53) @2.0GHz *Storage: 8GB (eMMC), 128MB (SPI NAND) Flash *Memory: 2GB (DDR4) SDRAM *WLAN: 2x2 2.4G + 3x3 5G (Wi-Fi 6) *PCIe: 1x M.2 (Key B), 1x M.2 (Key M) *USB: 1x USB 2.0 port *Network: 2x 2.5GbE ports
